name: How long does a typical garage conversion take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical garage conversion take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage-to-home-office conversion varies based on the scope of work and specific requirements. A standard conversion, involving insulation, drywall, flooring, electrical updates, and basic finishes, usually takes between 4 to 8 weeks from start to finish. More complex projects that include plumbing for a bathroom or extensive structural modifications may extend the duration. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical garage conversion takes 4-8 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and specific requirements.
